name: deadlines
teaches: Weekly deadlines with a day and a time ('drop out by Monday 9pm', 'final list goes up Tuesday at 8pm'), players confirming payment, and a kickoff time different from the organiser's entry.

history.author: Gemma Lowe
history.text: Drop out by Monday 9pm at the latest or you still pay

history.author: Gemma Lowe
history.text: Final list goes up Tuesday at 8pm. Kickoff Thursday 8pm at Hackney Marshes

history.author: Gemma Lowe
history.text: £6 each please to the usual account
